summary_en: The study tests D07001 softgel capsules plus capecitabine against placebo plus capecitabine in adults with advanced biliary tract cancer that has progressed after earlier chemotherapy. D07001 capsules are taken by mouth three times a week in 21-day cycles at 60 mg or 100 mg per day, or a placebo is taken, and capecitabine is taken by mouth twice a day for 14 days of each 21-day cycle. Treatment continues until disease progression, death, withdrawal of consent, or 12 cycles, whichever occurs first, and the main outcome measured is overall survival.
summary_es: El estudio evalúa las cápsulas blandas D07001 más capecitabina frente a placebo más capecitabina en adultos con cáncer de vías biliares avanzado que progresó después de quimioterapia previa. Las cápsulas D07001 se toman por vía oral tres veces por semana en ciclos de 21 días, a dosis de 60 mg o 100 mg por día, o se toma placebo, y la capecitabina se toma por vía oral dos veces al día durante 14 días de cada ciclo de 21 días. El tratamiento continúa hasta la progresión de la enfermedad, la muerte, el retiro del consentimiento o 12 ciclos, lo que ocurra primero, y el resultado principal medido es la supervivencia global.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older with unresectable, locally advanced or metastatic biliary tract cancer.
Measurable disease by RECIST v1.1 on central review.
Prior gemcitabine plus cisplatin-based chemotherapy failed, and FOLFOX or irinotecan plus fluorouracil failed or was refused.
ECOG performance status of 0 to 2 and life expectancy of at least 12 weeks.
Blood count, liver, kidney and clotting results within the levels specified in the record.
not_for: Active cancer other than biliary tract cancer within the past 2 years, with some exceptions.
Grade 2 or higher residual toxicity from prior chemotherapy or chemoradiation.
Gastrointestinal conditions or surgery that would significantly impede oral drug absorption.
Uncontrolled heart disease, active uncontrolled infection, or other serious condition judged by the investigator to preclude safe participation.
